messages:
cara (support): FYI customer reporting repeated 500s + high tail latency on dedicated cluster EU pool since ~10:22 UTC. they provided a request id: req_20260317_9f3a
acme-admin: yes, started around 10:21. request id req_20260317_9f3a and another one req_20260317_9f3b. we can repro with curl.
ryan (sre): thanks — can you paste the minimal curl you used and the pod/node it hit? also which model endpoint?
acme-admin: curl below, hit endpoint /v1/generate on model raven-1-dedicated, hits pod inference-pod-57 on node dedicated-gpu-eu-03
acme-admin: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Request-Id: req_20260317_9f3a" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate```
cara (support): collecting logs now. acme shared a cluster debug bundle id earlier but looks partial. requesting full node dmesg and pod logs.
devin (infra): ryan, I can SSH node and grab nvidia-smi snapshot + dmesg. planning commands: `ssh gpu@dedicated-gpu-eu-03 sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg-req_9f3a.log` and `kubectl -n dedicated logs inference-pod-57 --since=30m > /tmp/pod-req_9f3a.log`
ryan (sre): also grab GPU stats: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv` and `tegrastats` if present. include `journalctl -u inferenced.service --since "2026-03-17 10:00"`
deploy-bot: deploy finished on raven-1-dedicated @ 2026-03-17T09:58:12Z (commit a1b2c3). no canary failures.
acme-admin: attaching short pod logs snippet: 
"2026-03-17T10:21:34.123Z inference INFO request=req_20260317_9f3a recv payload"
"2026-03-17T10:21:34.456Z inference WARN request=req_20260317_9f3a kv_cache_miss"
"2026-03-17T10:22:00.891Z inference ERROR request=req_20260317_9f3a generate: timeout waiting for token loop"
ryan (sre): those errors line up with a GPU stall window. acme, can you run curl with `-H "X-Debug: 1"` so our runtime returns internal route headers (route, shard, kernel) for the request?
acme-admin: running now, will paste output. also happy to grant a short SSH window for infra to run collect script.
cara (support): please run the repro with the debug header and include full response headers. also we've created a pre-signed S3 bucket for upload: s3://redwood-debug-uploads/acme/req_20260317_9f3a/
devin (infra): i'll grab node snapshots. plan to run `/opt/redwood/scripts/gather_debug.sh --request-id req_20260317_9f3a --pod inference-pod-57 --node dedicated-gpu-eu-03 --out /tmp/debug-req_9f3a.tar.gz` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/debug-req_9f3a.tar.gz s3://redwood-debug-uploads/acme/req_20260317_9f3a/`
acme-admin: uploaded curl output to that S3 path, plus a small `/var/log/pod.log` excerpt.
ryan (sre): good. can you also run `kubectl exec -n dedicated inference-pod-57 -- cat /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/0/information` and drop it into the bundle?
acme-admin: done and uploaded. bundle now contains: pod.log, nvidia-smi.csv, dmesg tail, service journal, kernel oops none.
devin (infra): snapshot of `nvidia-smi` during the incident: "GPU 0, utilization.gpu [%]: 99, utilization.memory [%]: 82, memory.used [MiB]: 22987, memory.total [MiB]: 24576". also observed one XID 62 at 10:22:01 in dmesg (possible GPU timeout).
ryan (sre): XID 62 usually points to a GPU reset triggered by kernel for a long-running kernel. let's correlate with model kernel size and sequence length. cara, can support get the customer prompt length distribution for the window?
cara (support): asked acme for recent traffic sample (10:15-10:25). they provided one: mostly short prompts but a few long streams with seq ~2048 tokens.
acme-admin: confirming long streaming session at 10:20 that matches request req_20260317_9f3b.
ryan (sre): next steps: devin will include full debug tarball on S3. infra to check for driver/firmware mismatches and kernel abortion logs. support to ship repro curl + debug header and verify if using a quantized model variant increases risk.
devin (infra): uploaded debug tarball to s3://redwood-debug-uploads/acme/req_20260317_9f3a/debug-req_9f3a.tar.gz (checksum sha256: 3f2a...ef1c). giving access to ryan and cara for 48h.
cara (support): thanks. acme, once infra gives greenlight, can you run a short canary against a non-dedicated fallback (shared pool) so we can confirm if issue is infra-specific?
acme-admin: can do. scheduling now.
ryan (sre): i'll follow up after driver check. adding label `priority:sev3` and will update thread with findings. :thumbsup:
cara (support): closing loop for now — bundle and curl repro confirmed. leaving thread open for postmortem.
